_comment: THERMAL — Error Code Registry. Each code has (a) truePrescription = real fix, (b) manualPrescription = what the MANUAL tab says (30% are intentionally wrong). If manual is wrong, truth lives in the referenced operator log. Fix trigger: all 4 conditions simultaneously satisfied → overlay closes. During active error: linear-interp deterioration boost + screen shake on wrong input. Resources used for combo are TEMPORARY overrides; after FIXED, player rebalances manually. SURVEY tab cells act as combo-input pads during ER (all 40 cells clickable); CRM drift mini-game is NOT part of ER input.

_schemaComment.valveSeq: array of valve ids (V1-V4) in required click order; wrong click resets sequence
_schemaComment.soundSeq: array of SURVEY grid cell ids (A1-E8, 5x8 grid) in required click order
_schemaComment.manualLies: if true, manualPrescription contradicts truth; player must consult logReference
_schemaComment.logRef: operator log id that contains the real fix recipe

_scheduleComment: Auto-spawn timing for ER. firstMs is min delay before the FIRST ER of a shift; firstRnd is added randomly. After resolution, next ER waits respawnMs + random(respawnRnd). All in ms. shiftScale tightens timing on later shifts (multiplied per shift number).

schedule._cascadeComment: From shift `cascadeShift` onward, after each ER is resolved the next one queues with `cascadeMs + random(cascadeRnd)` instead of the normal respawn — almost no breathing room.

codes.title: COOLANT LOOP PHASE DRIFT
codes.manualText: Re-seat coolant phase by cycling valves in ascending order. Confirm with tone pair A1→C4.

codes.title: SECONDARY PRESSURE OSCILLATION
codes.manualText: Vent through V2 then V4. Stabilize with B2→D3 sequence. Do not raise pressure allocation.

codes.title: BUS HARMONIC MISMATCH
codes.manualText: Raise power to 8 to overcome harmonic. Vent V3→V2→V4. Double-strike D3.

codes.title: CORE LOOP STAGNATION
codes.manualText: Re-establish loop flow: P6 / Pr4. V1→V3. Full ascending tone sweep A1→B2→C4.

codes.title: CONTAINMENT SEAL RESONANCE
codes.manualText: Reduce pressure to 3. Alternate V4→V2→V4. Single C4 pulse to close resonance.

codes.title: GENERATOR FIELD LAG
codes.manualText: Boost field: P7/Pr3. V1→V4 vent pair. Single B2 tone to re-lock.

codes.title: HEAT EXCHANGER STUTTER
codes.manualText: Balanced load P4/Pr4. Single V2 vent. Double A1 tap clears stutter.

codes.title: FEEDWATER LINE TREMOR
codes.manualText: P3/Pr6. V3→V1→V2 in order. Descend D3→B2 to dampen tremor.

codes.title: TURBINE TORQUE DRIFT
codes.manualText: P6/Pr2. V4→V1 vent. C4→D3 to align torque.

codes.title: CONDENSER BACKFLOW
codes.manualText: Symmetric load P5/Pr5. V2→V3. Ascend B2→C4 to reverse backflow.

codes._tierComment: ── TIER 2 — appears from shift 4+ — longer sequences, harder ──
codes.title: PRIMARY EXCHANGER CASCADE
codes.manualText: Cascade reset: P5/Pr5. Valve cycle V2→V4→V1→V3→V2 (note V2 repeats). Triple ascending tones A1→B2→C4 to lock.

codes.title: DUAL-LOOP HARMONIC LOCK
codes.manualText: Boost POWER to 8 to overcome dual-loop harmonic. Valve cycle V3→V1→V4→V2→V3. Tone pattern D3→B2→D3.

codes.title: TURBINE PHASE INVERSION
codes.manualText: P9/Pr1. Reverse-cycle V4→V2→V3→V1. Tone double-strike C4 then close A1.

codes.title: SECONDARY HEAT REJECT FAILURE
codes.manualText: P7/Pr6. Cycle V1→V4→V2→V3→V1. Tones B2→C4→B2 to bracket the reject window.

codes.title: GRID DESYNCHRONIZATION CASCADE
codes.manualText: P3/Pr7. Cycle V2→V3→V4→V1→V2. Tone bracket D3→A1→D3.
